# Bundled PDF dependencies

- html2canvas 1.4.1: `html2canvas.min.js`, MIT license in `html2canvas-LICENSE`. Source: https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas
- jsPDF 4.2.1: `jspdf.umd.min.js`, MIT license in `jspdf-LICENSE`. Source: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF

Pinned distribution files are bundled for local/offline export. No CDN requests are made at runtime. Upgrade deliberately and rerun the PDF download and visual-layout tests.
